Context

Pure Data (Pd) is a graphical programming environment for real-time audio, with multimedia extensions. Patches connect objects through visible inlets, outlets, and cords. Official overview.

Observed

  • Small rectangular boxes carry monospaced object names.
  • Dark lines connect ports on a white canvas.
  • The patch reads as a chain of operations; geometry carries meaning.
  • The drawing has little decoration beyond the working elements.

Borrow

Show relationships directly. Keep component boundaries and names visible. Let a useful diagram become the interface.

This interpretation describes the documented patch aesthetic; custom patches and extensions can look different.
